title: •Wooof
caption: •Wooof (V)
game_text: {pilot:3}. Wooof may deploy with any cruiser using Combat Response. When deployed, may draw top card from Reserve Deck. During your deploy phase, if piloting Jabba’s Space Cruiser, may ▼ one Jabba aboard (for free).
lore: Kadas’sa’Nikto. One of Jabba’s best pilots. Often pilots Jabba’s space yacht. *Smuggler*. Prefers to be flying combat starfighters.
copyright: TM & © 1998 LUCASFILM LTD. TM, ® & © 1998 DECIPHER INC.
notes: Unique. Stats POWER 2 / ABILITY 2 (same as printed); deploy 2 / forfeit 4 (printed 3 / 2). Inline yellow DS pilot-power icon followed by '3.' → {pilot:3} (stub expands 'Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots'); ▼ where the stub expands the deploy phrase. Icon column: pilot (DS helmet). Alien. Lore corrected from the 745 px V1 face: 'Smuggler' bold (period not bold), curly apostrophes (Kadas’sa’Nikto, Jabba’s ×2). Base page 'Wooof' (printed archive face; 'Wooof (PC Errata)' is the AR 2023 errata). art.src = JabbasPalace-D-wooof-decipher-archive.gif, a square-on 350×490 scan (not a white-page photo); JP-D-wooof.gif (349×489) also downloaded. Modern: V1-D-wooof.gif (745 px) — NOTE its strip reads 'E1' and its game text is PC errata, not this slip; same art and printed lore, copyright 1998 Hoth-style line legible; used for art only. VB3-D-wooof-pre.gif (350, the reissue of this slip) also downloaded to src/vs8/modern/50-VB3-D-wooof-pre.gif.
